description: New medicines authorised for the European Union market by the European Medicines Agency, in a date window. Returns brand name, active substance / INN, therapeutic area and indication, marketing-authorisation holder, authorisation date and EPAR link. Answers "which drugs did the EMA approve in July 2026", "recent EU drug approvals", "new EU marketing authorisations this year". Filtered on the marketing-authorisation date, which is the date an initial authorisation was granted.

from.description: Earliest authorisation date. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

month.description: Convenience for a single month, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-07). Overrides from/to.

to.description: Latest authorisation date. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

name: ema_recent_approvals
title: Ema Recent Approvals
